solution:
Here the correct answer is** "a - 2, b - 3, c - 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 3**, which is **"a - 2, b - 3, c - 1".**
 
• This can be inferred from the table provided in the passage, where the weight of each satellite is listed next to its name and number.
 
• Let's refer to the following lines of the passage:-
 
 
• *“New experiments include mm-Wave Humidity Sounder and Spectrum Monitoring Payload. **Janus-1**, a **10.2 kg **satellite belongs to ANTARIS, USA. A **8.7 kg** satellite** AzaadiSAT-2 **is a combined effort of about 750 girl students across India guided by Space Kidz India, Chennai,” it added.*
 
• *"The **EOS-07** satellite weighs **156.3 kg** and is made by ISRO."*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct matching of satellites with their weight is **a - 2, b - 3, c - 1.**
